name.en-US: To the Donatists after the Conference
name.es-419: A los donatistas después de la conferencia

description.en-US: Addressed to the Donatist laity after the Conference of Carthage, answering their bishops' claim that the judge had been bribed and showing from the proceedings that the Donatist case had been defeated.
description.pt-BR: Dirigido aos fiéis donatistas depois da Conferência de Cartago, responde à alegação de seus bispos de que o juiz fora subornado e mostra, pelas atas, que a causa donatista foi vencida.
description.la: Ad Donatistarum plebem post collationem Carthaginiensem scriptus: respondet episcopis eorum iudicem praemio corruptum esse iactantibus, et ex gestis ostendit causam Donatistarum victam esse.
